title: Identification of Key Efferocytosis-Related Genes and Mechanisms in Diabetic Retinopathy.
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过机器学习分析糖尿病视网膜病变中胞葬相关基因，仅涉及转录因子调控预测，无蛋白质-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: This study aimed to explore the key efferocytosis-related genes in diabetic retinopathy (DR) and their regulatory mechanisms. Public DR-related gene expression datasets, GSE160306 (training) and GSE60436 (validation), were downloaded. Differentially expressed efferocytosis-related genes (DEERGs) were analyzed using differential expression analysis and weighted gene co-expression network analysis. Functional enrichment analysis was conducted. Moreover, efferocytosis-related signature genes were identified using machine learning analysis, and their expression levels and diagnostic value were analyzed. Furthermore, nomograms were constructed; immune cell infiltration was analyzed; and gene set enrichment analysis, transcriptional regulation analysis, and small-molecule drug (SMD) prediction of efferocytosis-related signature genes were performed. In total, 36 DEERGs were identified in DR, and were markedly enriched in multiple functions, such as visual system development. Through further machine learning analysis, two efferocytosis-related signature genes, Ferritin Light Chain (FTL) and Fc Gamma Binding Protein (FCGBP), were identified, and were found to be upregulated in DR samples and showed high diagnostic performance for DR. A nomogram constructed using FTL and FCGBP accurately predicted the risk of DR. Moreover, the level of infiltration of immature B cells was positively correlated with FTL and FCGBP expression levels. Multiple transcription factors (TFs), such as CCCTC-Binding Factor (CTCF) and KLF Transcription Factor 9 (KLF9), were found to interact with both FTL and FCGBP. In addition, FTL can be targeted by miRNAs, such as miR-22-3p, and FCGBP can be targeted by miR-7973. In addition, both FTL and FCGBP can be targeted by SMDs, such as bisphenol A. Key efferocytosis-related genes, such as FTL and FCGBP, may promote DR development. Detecting or targeting FTL and FCGBP may aid in the prevention, diagnosis, and treatment of DR.
abstract_zh: 本研究旨在探讨糖尿病视网膜病变（DR）中关键的胞葬作用相关基因及其调控机制。下载了公开的DR相关基因表达数据集GSE160306（训练集）和GSE60436（验证集）。通过差异表达分析和加权基因共表达网络分析，筛选出差异表达的胞葬作用相关基因（DEERGs）。进行了功能富集分析。此外，利用机器学习分析鉴定了胞葬作用相关特征基因，并分析了其表达水平和诊断价值。进一步构建了列线图；分析了免疫细胞浸润；并对胞葬作用相关特征基因进行了基因集富集分析、转录调控分析及小分子药物（SMD）预测。共在DR中鉴定出36个DEERGs，这些基因显著富集于多种功能，如视觉系统发育。通过进一步的机器学习分析，鉴定出两个胞葬作用相关特征基因，即铁蛋白轻链（FTL）和Fc gamma结合蛋白（FCGBP），发现它们在DR样本中表达上调，并对DR表现出较高的诊断性能。基于FTL和FCGBP构建的列线图能准确预测DR风险。此外，未成熟B细胞的浸润水平与FTL和FCGBP表达水平呈正相关。多种转录因子（TFs），如CCCTC结合因子（CTCF）和KLF转录因子9（KLF9），被发现与FTL和FCGBP均存在相互作用。另外，FTL可被miRNAs（如miR-22-3p）靶向，FCGBP可被miR-7973靶向。此外，FTL和FCGBP均可被SMDs（如双酚A）靶向。关键的胞葬作用相关基因，如FTL和FCGBP，可能促进DR的发展。检测或靶向FTL和FCGBP可能有助于DR的预防、诊断和治疗。
